title: Workspaces
mobileDescription: Search projects and select a session to view its history.
deleteDescription: Removes this workspace from the list. Local files and saved conversations are kept.
deleteBusy: A conversation in this workspace is running or saving. Try again shortly.
deleteFailed: Could not delete workspace. Try again.
projectDescription: Name your project and select an existing folder as its working directory.
emptyProjects: Start a conversation or add a project folder.
invalidDirectory: Cannot access this folder. Check the path.
createFailed: Could not create project. Try again.
modelRequired: Configure a model in global settings first.
